testcase.name: a confirmed system delete is the only ordinary route to SECURED
only observed removal ever yields SECURED, for every outcome that exists
a lost permission is a failure, never a silent success
a provider that cannot delete leaves the item as original-remains
a user who declines keeps their file and the app says so
no outcome resolves to a pending state, because pending is not an answer
an already missing original counts as confirmed, because nothing is there to find
